info.description: Regression pack for the practice bank app. Run top to bottom on freshly reset data (00 Setup does the reset).

item.name: TC-LGN-01 valid login returns token and user

exec: pm.test("user details", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.user.username).to.eql("asha"); pm.expect(j.user.full_name).to.eql("Asha Reddy"); });
pm.test("message does not say which field was wrong", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Invalid username or password"); });
